key_terms.صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّم: Peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: Who does 'Al al-Nabi' refer to in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi’s commentary clarifies that 'Al al-Nabi' specifically denotes the Ahl al-Bayt, establishing their unique spiritual and political authority distinct from the broader community during the transition from the Age of Ignorance. This identification is crucial in Shia exegesis for linking the Prophet's household to the concept of divine guidance and purity, often cited alongside the Verse of Purification. It underscores their role as the true inheritors of the Prophet's message amidst the rise of hypocrites.
